item.title: The 500 colleges where former students aren't repaying their loans, and why
item.description: Federal data shows many borrowers who aren't paying their loans went to private, for-profit colleges — schools that often market to low-income students and rely on federal financial aid for revenue.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The price tag for the Iran war has hit over $30B, reports say
item.description: Two new reports detail the damage the Iran war has caused to U.S. bases and the rising cost of the war, which has hit over $30 billion.

item.title: U.S. acknowledges for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space
item.description: The remarkable revelation comes after previous warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponizing a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

item.title: 3 people killed when news helicopter crashes while covering LA bus accident
item.description: A news helicopter used by NBC and Telemundo crashed in a Los Angeles neighborhood on Tuesday, killing at least three people while reporters were covering the nearby crash of an SUV and a city bus.

item.title: Judge blocks DHS from acting against a man over a harsh email to an ICE official
item.description: ICE agents turned up at David Streever's home over a harsh email he sent to an ICE official. Now a court order prevents the federal government from making additional threats against him.

item.title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon call for curbs on AI
item.description: The rare pairing of a progressive leader and a MAGA voice is a sign of how worries over rapidly advancing AI are upending political alliances. But their policy proposals are far apart.
